verdict.rationale: Figma offers a REST API and Plugin API that can extract objects, layers, and properties (figma-docs-7, figma-docs-26, figma-docs-32), suggesting some data extraction is possible, but there is no documented full-fidelity open-format export or bulk data-portability path, and a hands-on community report explicitly states user work is 'locked up in a proprietary format' with no way to keep an up-to-date local copy without constant manual export (figma-comm-7). Missing for 10: a documented bulk/open-format export tool or data-portability guarantee, and independent confirmation that full designs (not just metadata) can be losslessly exported and reused elsewhere.
